title: TimeSplitters 2 (TimeSplitters 2 Recomp)
description: Crystal Cut: a native PC port of TimeSplitters 2 (PS2, USA and PAL) with cut content restored from your own disc. Windows, Linux and Steam Deck, 60 FPS, true 16:9, up to 8x resolution, online play. Statically recompiled and checked against PCSX2. No game files included.
